definition: a job for a band for a set time
description: In an old seaside dance hall with tall arched windows and string lights across the ceiling, a man in a cream linen suit and tie shakes hands with a young woman with curly hair in a green satin top and black wide trousers, holding up two fingers with his other hand; both smile. Then she lets go, turns and walks happily toward the stage, waving him along. Behind them musicians set up: a woman with a double bass and another woman with a drum. A roller door stands open onto a boardwalk.

taps.phrase: to wear a green satin top

taps.target: the musician with the double bass
